verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Basecamp exposing itself to external AI agents: "full MCP support" for ChatGPT and Claude, plus a CLI and skills. That is the MCP-server direction and does not transfer to this story. Nothing in the pack shows Basecamp acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers and uses their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
